reconstruction.stdout_tail_redacted: Canonical runner completed the integration group and reported 21 of 37 files, 382 tests, 363 passed, and 19 failed.
reconstruction.stderr_tail_redacted: Child-process consumers reported spawnSync EPERM while status and bounded output were also present.

root_cause: The historical run cannot be conclusively attributed because its exit status, signal, per-file output, and process snapshot were not retained. An exact 21-of-37 reconstruction shows that the runner did not disappear: it completed the first three groups, then stopped by design after integration failures. In the restricted agent sandbox, synchronous child-process calls returned EPERM despite also containing status and bounded output. The identical HTTPS clone and SHA passed 37 of 37 files and 570 of 570 tests outside that restriction. This confirms a sandbox-context failure mode matching the historical boundary, but does not retroactively upgrade the incomplete historical record to conclusive evidence.
regression_test: test/harness/runner-contract.test.mjs — canonical runner publishes bounded per-file diagnostics and audits
resolution: Add opt-in bounded diagnostics, process audit, and temporary-file audit to preserve future exit, signal, duration, child-process, active-handle, and temp cleanup evidence. Do not weaken fail-closed child-process tests or treat a retry as closure. Final closure requires three new consecutive independent HTTPS clones on one unchanged final head.
